title: helmdeck marketplace catalog index
description: Schema for the top-level index.yaml. The helmdeck control plane fetches this file at startup and on POST /api/v1/marketplace/refresh to enumerate the catalog without walking every pack directory.

catalog_version.description: Marketplace catalog format version. Bumped only on breaking schema changes. v0.13.0 ships v1.

updated_at.description: Last updated timestamp (RFC 3339). Populated by the validate.yml workflow on every commit to main.

name.description: Pack name. Must match the helmdeck-pack.yaml in `path`.

version.description: Pack version. Must match the helmdeck-pack.yaml in `path`.

path.description: Directory containing the pack, relative to repo root. Convention: packs/<name>/.

description.description: One-line catalog blurb. May be shorter than the manifest's full description.

installs.description: Cumulative install count. Populated by the helmdeck telemetry pipeline (#33); operators can ignore in PR submissions.

stars.description: User stars from the future consumer marketplace (#33). Operators can ignore in PR submissions.
